name: The Defias Brotherhood
summary: In Westfall, Gryan Stoutmantle suspects the Defias Brotherhood has ties to Stormwind's old Stonemasons Guild. He sends you there with Wiley's Note.

sections.title: A Slip of the Tongue
sections.body: Wiley's mention of the Stonemasons catches Gryan's attention. The guild rebuilt Stormwind City after the First War, but many believe it scattered or dissolved. If the Defias are linked to the guild, Westfall's rural insurgency may be more than a band of outlaws.

sections.title: Old Town Secrets
sections.body: Gryan cannot test his suspicions from Sentinel Hill, so he sends you to Master Mathias Shaw, head of Stormwind's covert intelligence wing, SI:7. Shaw works from the Barracks in Old Town, gathering whispers and secrets from across the realm. He may untangle the Defias Brotherhood's origins.

sections.title: The Shadow Over the Crown
sections.body: When you bring Wiley's Note to Master Mathias Shaw, he sees that Westfall's rebellion runs deeper than Gryan understands. It also carries greater political complexity. Its roots reach into Stormwind's turbulent past.

faq.q: Why does Gryan Stoutmantle send you to Stormwind?
faq.answer: Wiley's Note mentions the Stonemasons, leading Gryan Stoutmantle to suspect political intrigue behind the banditry. He sends you to Master Mathias Shaw to confirm the connection.
Master Mathias Shaw leads SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence and espionage branch. He works from the Barracks in Old Town.

faq.q: Where do I find Mathias Shaw?
faq.answer: You find Master Mathias Shaw on the second floor of the SI:7 headquarters in the Barracks of Old Town, Stormwind City.

faq.q: What is the connection between the Defias and the Stonemasons?
faq.answer: The Stonemasons Guild rebuilt Stormwind after its destruction in the First War. Gryan Stoutmantle suspects Wiley's mention of the guild links it to the Defias, and Mathias Shaw may confirm or deny the connection.

Wiley's Note comes from Wiley the Black, a scoundrel Gryan Stoutmantle has dealt with before. It warns that the Defias are plotting with gnolls, kobolds, and goblins. Wiley's mention of the Stonemasons may link the Defias Brotherhood to the former guild.

faq.q: Does Highlord Bolvar or the boy-king know about this?
faq.answer: Covert state matters pass through Mathias Shaw and SI:7 before reaching Highlord Bolvar Fordragon and the throne. Shaw says the matter may be more complex than Stoutmantle realizes.

angles.text: At SI:7 headquarters, you meet Mathias Shaw, grandmaster of Stormwind's rogues and spies. His work connects Westfall's local turmoil to wider tradecraft.
As a human of Stormwind, you see Westfall's lawless frontier meet the bitter political scandals left unresolved after the rebuilding of your capital.
As an Alliance member, you see fractures within the Alliance's primary kingdom. Some threats come from betrayed citizens, not monstrous outsiders.
